description: This file defines a Spring service class WebAuthnService that handles WebAuthn ceremonies such as registration and authentication. It manages challenges, interacts with repositories to save state, and provides methods to initiate and complete WebAuthn flows with minimal cryptographic validation.

classes.name: WebAuthnService
classes.description: A Spring @Service class providing WebAuthn registration and authentication flows, managing challenges, authenticators, and user credentials.

methods.name: beginRegistration
methods.description: Creates a registration challenge, stores it, and returns options for the client to initiate WebAuthn registration.

methods.name: finishRegistration
methods.description: Completes registration by consuming the challenge, storing the new authenticator, and performing minimal validation.

methods.name: beginAuthentication
methods.description: Creates an authentication challenge, stores it, and returns options for the client to initiate WebAuthn authentication.

methods.name: finishAuthentication
methods.description: Completes authentication by consuming the challenge, verifying the credential, and updating the sign count.
